name: ambience
source:
Main character lives in a mansion with his maid Lease Frau who allows him to avoid socializing. One day he receives a letter from his cousin Liana who is forced to serve at king's court and who wants to spend the leftover time before separation together with main character...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与女仆莉丝芙劳一同住在宅邸里。在她的照料下，主人公得以避开所有社交往来。某天，他收到表姐妹莉安娜的来信。莉安娜被迫前往王宫侍奉国王，希望在两人被迫分离前，能与主人公共度最后的时光……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
